description: T-28D-5, ex USAF 49-1687 from the data plate. Displayed in the park since 1985; restored and noted April 2023.

Ex Royal Thai Army STOL observation aircraft, ex HS-PCA c/n 55190/4. In the park since at least 2001 and repeatedly repainted and remarked (5190, 515, unmarked); externally restored, mounted on plinths and marked 5075 by December 2015.
